data.description: This spell functions like magic fang, except that the enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls is +1 per four caster levels [maximum +5]. This bonus does not allow a natural weapon or unarmed strike to bypass damage reduction aside from magic. Alternatively, you may imbue all of the creature's natural weapons with a +1 enhancement bonus [regardless of your caster level]. Greater magic fang can be made permanent with a permanency spell.
